name: Sky Fix
alt: A round position puck on a small street patch with an accuracy ring around it, and three small satellites with solar panels above, dashed lines running from one of them down to the puck.

name: Saved Region
alt: A shallow open drawer with a finger pull, and above it a map region split into nine thin tiles; one corner tile already sits inside the drawer.

name: Rolling Road
alt: A car standing on a belt that runs round two rollers on a floor plate, with a round cooling fan on a stand in front of its nose.

name: Push Keys
alt: A slim rounded panel with four round push buttons in a row; the third is pressed in, with a bright rim and centre dot.

name: Next Turn
alt: A four-way crossroads with a raised route ribbon coming up the near road and curving right into the far-right road.

name: Lane Gantry
alt: A straight three-lane road crossed by a sign gantry with a panel over each lane; the middle panel is swung out and its lane stripe is lit.

name: Trip Rail
alt: A long slim rail with a round puck on it; along its side stand a short queue of cars, a map pin and a charging post, the pin drawn bright.

name: Heads Up
alt: A car driving away up a road, seen from behind and to its left, with a small pane floating just ahead of its windscreen showing a bright little road that curves into the bend.

name: Arrival Dial
alt: A short road from a round start puck to a clock dial on a post, with a small puck on the road as the car and the road behind it drawn bright.

name: Through the Wheel
alt: A car dashboard with an instrument pod under a curved hood: two round gauges with needles and a small screen showing a short route between them, seen through a three-spoke steering wheel.

name: Charge Ahead
alt: A battery pack with five raised cells beside a road that runs from a start puck past a charging post to a map pin; three cells are full.

name: Road Profile
alt: An S-curved road with a dashed centre line and, above it on dashed posts, a narrow ribbon that follows its bends and rises and falls, one stretch lit with a line dropping to the road.

name: Snap Line
for: Snap to Roads and map-matched location
alt: A gently curving road with faint GPS dots scattered either side; near the start a few dots sit on the road, joined by a bright line.

name: Black Box
alt: A small rounded recorder case with a handle, a strip of paper curling out of its slot along the ground, and five event dots on stems above it, one lit.

name: Measured Car
alt: A car framed by dashed dimension lines with end ticks along its side, across its front and standing at its rear; the length line is lit.

name: Day Night Tile
alt: A map tile held between two posts on a low base, leaning toward the viewer, with streets, a river and a park on top; turned over, its underside shows the same streets lined with dots for street lights.

name: Camera Orbit
alt: A small camera with a lens rides a curved rail arching over a map tile, its lens turned on the tile.

name: Map Print
alt: A server box with vents and a status light, a map sheet with streets, a river and a park sliding out of a slot in its front like a print.

name: Open Sign
for: POI details: contact and opening hours
alt: A flat-roofed shop with a wide window and a door, a sign plate hanging from a bracket at its corner; near the pointer the plate turns to show a clock face and the door is outlined bright.

name: Request Deck
alt: Six thin cards standing in a tray, each with a different route line on it; the card under the pointer stands up with its route bright while the others lean away.

name: Toll Gate
alt: A short road with a small roofed toll booth on an island beside it and a barrier arm across the lane; as the pointer nears, the arm swings up.

name: Detour
alt: A street plan of three low blocks with a roadworks barrier across the main road; near the barrier the route bends off up a cross street, round the middle block and back down.

name: Speaker Grille
alt: A car door panel with a pull slot and a round speaker set low in it: a raised rim with screws around a grille of dots, the dots near the pointer pushed out.

name: Speed Camera
alt: A straight road with a dashed centre line, a camera box on a post at its far end facing oncoming traffic, a barred zone strip on the road before it, and a round car puck.

name: Pause Point
alt: A winding route from a round start puck to a map pin, with a notched bookmark on a short stem standing partway along it; the route behind it is bright, the route ahead dashed.

name: Limit Ring
alt: A large round sign with a broad ring and a blank centre on a tall post beside a road, a car puck on the road, and part of the sign's rim lit.

name: Type Ahead
alt: A search bar standing like a screen, a pill-shaped field with a caret and a round button, with three suggestion bars under it; one slides out toward the viewer.

name: Radius Sweep
alt: A round position puck with a search ring on the ground and eight map pins around it; the pins inside the ring float up on dashed lines.

name: Roadside Finds
alt: A road with one bend inside a dashed corridor; map pins stand along it, and those in the corridor near the pointer rise while dim pins outside stay put.

name: Pin to Door
alt: Three gabled houses in a row with a map pin overhead; the pin settles over the house under the pointer and its door and door plate light up.

name: Relief Tile
alt: A square terrain tile on a thin plinth, its surface cut into parallel strips that follow two ridges and a valley, with a dot on the rim marking the sun.

name: Sensor Stack
alt: A position puck on the ground, linked to three sensors on round plinths behind it: a dish, an upright wheel and a gyroscope.

name: Head Unit
alt: A car dashboard with a steering wheel, a wide head-unit screen and a phone in a cradle showing a route, joined by a cable.

name: Open Sockets
alt: A charging post with a small screen and three round sockets; the middle one has a plug in it, its cable lying in a loop beside the post.

name: Plug Fit
alt: A round charging plug, flattened on one side and turned off-angle, hovering on its cable above a matching socket with five pin holes.

name: Pocket Route
alt: An open drawer holding one map tile; a route steps across the tile from a start dot to an end dot.

name: Patch Tile
alt: A three-by-three grid of map tiles; one tile is lifted out and a fresh tile with a new street drops into its slot.

name: Token Blocks
alt: A navigation panel beside a tray of four small blocks; one block is lifted and the panel part it controls is outlined.

name: Route Sleeve
alt: A thin map card half inside a folder sleeve with a thumb cut; pulled out, a route with two end dots is drawn across it.
